brand_identity.name: Purnabramha
brand_identity.tagline: World's First Intelligent Restaurant Chain Powered by A.AI Technology
brand_identity.vibe: Ultra-premium, mysterious, cinematic, regal Maharashtrian heritage mixed with futuristic intelligence.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium

spacing_and_layout.surface_styles: Use 1px subtle borders (border-[#2A151A]) with flat backgrounds. Avoid heavy drop shadows; rely on lighting, texture, and contrast.

components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-[#0A0505]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/5. z-50 fixed w-full.
components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none). Primary button: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#F3D060] transition-colors. Secondary: border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10.
components.cards: Flat design with 1px border. Deep wine/charcoal background (#140A0B). Interactive cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and brighten border on hover. Internal padding must be generous (p-8).
components.inputs: Shadcn UI customized: bg-[#1A0D0E] border-[#2A151A] rounded-none focus-visible:ring-[#D4AF37] text-[#FDFBF7].

animations.hero: Slow fade and scale-up on load (1.05 to 1.0).
animations.scroll: Staggered reveal for menu items and bento grids using Framer Motion.

hero_background.description: Dark luxury restaurant interior for the main hero.

hero_food.description: Premium creamy dal on dark background for featured dishes.

about_chef.description: Black and white focused chef in dramatic lighting.

tech_ai_bg.description: Abstract golden nodes for the A.AI technology section.

logo_placeholder.description: Elegant restaurant logo placeholder on glass.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the defined color palette to override Tailwind's default configuration in tailwind.config.js.
For the hero section, use a heavy black overlay (bg-black/50 or darker) over the background image to ensure text legibility. Never use raw image without scrim.
Use Framer Motion for revealing elements on scroll, avoiding overly bouncy animations. Keep them smooth, slow, and cinematic.
Ensure the A.AI feature is highlighted using the tech_ai_bg combined with gold textual accents.
All headings must use Cormorant Garamond, tightly tracked (tracking-tight), and body text should use Outfit.
Do NOT use typical card shadows (shadow-md). Rely strictly on 1px borders of #2A151A and flat surface colors.

Include an infinite scrolling marquee using react-fast-marquee with the text 'WORLD'S FIRST INTELLIGENT RESTAURANT CHAIN • PURE VEGETARIAN • POWERED BY A.AI'. Use an outline style or subtle gold text on a deep background.
Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) for robust testing.
Use Shadcn UI for complex interactives (Forms, Tabs, Modals) but customize their styling heavily to remove the 'Vercel default' look. Ensure border-radius is removed (rounded-none).
Nutrition modal must use Shadcn Dialog, stylized with the dark theme.
Images should never look 'pasted on'. Use subtle borders or inset shadows, and keep them contained within the grid layout.
